note: Every case is a parameter set, not a file: the input binary is regenerated
from these parameters (seed included), which is what lets this corpus be
committed and run in CI without shipping anyone's ROM data.
Expected outputs live in cases/<id>/golden.json and are rewritten by
_dev/corpus/update_golden.py — after READING the diff, never blind.
If a diff appears and the generator was not touched, the engine moved:
that is the signal this corpus exists for.

cases.note: The default shape: 256 KB, three 16-bit maps, little-endian.
Big-endian axes + cells, five maps of different shapes.
